title: Three Days of the Condor
writer: James Grady, Lorenzo Semple Jr., David Rayfiel
actors: Robert Redford, Faye Dunaway, Cliff Robertson
plot: A bookish CIA researcher in Manhattan finds all his co-workers dead, and must outwit those responsible until he figures out who he can really trust.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 6 wins & 4 nominations total
